sources.title: OpenCode — The open source AI coding agent
sources.content: OpenCode is an open source agent that helps you write code in your terminal, IDE, or desktop. Free models included or connect any model from any provider, including Claude, GPT, Gemini and more. LSP enabled: automatically loads the right LSPs for the LLM. Multi-session: start multiple agents in parallel on the same project. Share links: share a link to any session for reference or to debug. GitHub Copilot: log in with GitHub to use your Copilot account. ChatGPT Plus/Pro: log in with OpenAI. Any model: 75+ LLM providers through Models.dev, including local models. Any editor: available as a terminal interface, desktop app, and IDE extension. Built for privacy first: OpenCode does not store any of your code or context data. With over 208,000 GitHub stars, 950 contributors, over 13,000 commits, used and trusted by over 16M developers every month.

sources.title: OpenCode Download — Installazione e piattaforme
sources.content: OpenCode è disponibile in quattro forme principali. Terminal: installabile via curl, npm, bun, brew, paru, yay. Desktop: macOS (Apple Silicon e Intel), Windows (x64 e ARM64), Linux (.deb e .rpm). Extensions: VS Code, Cursor, Zed, Windsurf, VSCodium. Integrations: GitHub e GitLab. FAQ: What is OpenCode? How do I use OpenCode? Do I need extra AI subscriptions? Can I only use OpenCode in the terminal? How much does it cost? What about data and privacy? Is it open source?
